name: Sandrone
notes: A Cryo on-field Stellar-Conduct DPS that scales with ATK. Both sources put the Normal Attack first, then the Burst, then the Skill, so the damage talent is the Normal Attack; its hits are on the physical curve (76.3% at level 1, 1.081 at level 2). They agree on 4pc Disenchantment in Deep Shadow as best with Gilded Dreams as the back-up, and on A Teaspoon of Transcendence first and A Thousand Blazing Suns, Mailed Flower and Tidal Shadow after it. The mains differ a little: KQM gives ATK% on the Sands and Goblet and CRIT on the Circlet; Game8 allows EM on the Sands and Goblet and puts CRIT DMG at least level with CRIT Rate. Goals are Game8's: ATK 2,000 or more, CRIT Rate 30-40% before the set's CRIT Rate bonus and her ascension stat (40 used), CRIT DMG 180% or above, ER 125-145% (upper end; KQM: 130-165% with one other Cryo unit, 120-140% with two). Game8's EM of 150-200 is not set.
